A free, open-source **public beta** of a native Stremio-compatible client for older iPads. Browse your configured catalogs, keep a local library and continue watching with native or VLC playback.

No content, account credentials or paid provider access is included. Configure your own supported add-ons; their availability and playback vary.

**Rootful jailbreak, arm64 iPad, iOS 12.x only.** Tested on iPad mini 2 with iOS 12.5.8. This is not a rootless or modern-iOS package. The jailbreak must be active. Other devices have not been validated. Prefer 720p on this hardware; no universal codec, source, battery or 4K performance guarantee.

If StremIOS is already installed through an IPA, keep using that installation and update it with the IPA. This package deliberately refuses an automatic IPA-to-package migration. It never deletes your library, settings or add-on credentials. Package removal removes the app, not its saved data.
